story.title: BIG-bench 逻辑推理 · logical_deduction/three_objects
story.text: On a shelf, there are three books: a white book, a green book, and an orange book

constraints.text: The green book is to the right of the white book
The orange book is the rightmost

question_prompt: 谁排在从左数第 2 位？
options: The white book is the second from the left.
The green book is the second from the left.
The orange book is the second from the left.
hints: 把每条线索先翻译成“谁在谁前面/后面”。
把能确定的位置先固定下来，再继续推。
explanation: 来自 BIG-bench logical_deduction 第 13 例，由规则翻译器转换（Apache-2.0），未经人工改写。
